Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Striated Velvet Linen-Look Decorative Throw Pillow, 17" x 17", Henna
Colors: Henna
Materials: Polyester / velvet
Subtle striations give a modern twist to this classic velvet pillow, which comes in a variety of colors for easy mixing and matching. For a different look, flip the pillow around to display the solid linen-look fabric on the back. Modern refresh of classic velvet pillow Polyester. Front is velvet; back is smooth, linen-like fabric Removable plush fiber-filled insert included Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 17" x 17" Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
